853:t_35:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't say that, Bitter Hardship. Let's taste life's hardships together.」

853:t_36:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With $$ドラグーン$$ and full barrages, you're so good at fighting multiple foes that your shootdown count just keeps rising, $$キラ$$.」

853:t_36:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But just between us... Do you ever shoot an ally by mistake?」

853:t_36:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's all right. I make sure that never happens.」

853:t_36:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「So, $$ＡＧ$$... If I ever shoot you, it'll be because I aimed at you, not because of a stray shot.」

853:t_36:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haha... Hahaha... Thank you for that subtle threat.」

853:t_36:10.en:
$$キラ$$
「I don't want to do that either, so watch yourself.」

853:t_37:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought I might give you flowers to celebrate, but...」

853:t_37:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「No... Please don't go to any trouble.」

853:t_37:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $$刹那$$... You like flowers, don't you? You always have them in your room.」

853:t_37:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「The feelings held in those flowers... They give me strength.」

853:t_37:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But... I haven't even said anything yet...」

853:t_37:14.en:
$$刹那$$
「In a sense, it seems we understand each other.」

853:t_38:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. But please congratulate these guys too.」

853:t_38:5.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$ is an ace. $$ロックオン$$ is an ace.」

853:t_38:6.en:
$$青ハロ$$
「$$ハロ$$ worked hard. $$ハロ$$ worked hard.」

853:t_38:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. Congratulations to you too, $$ハロ$$ and $$青ハロ$$!」

853:t_38:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd like to follow your example, $$ハロ$$, release versions of myself in different colors and build a major franchise.」

853:t_38:9.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「They'd make fine targets for my wild shooting.」

853:t_38:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You say such outrageous things with such a cool expression...」

853:t_39:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And $$ピーリス$$, $$ハレルヤ$$ and $$マリー$$ too!」

853:t_39:5.en:
$$マリー$$
「It seems we've put you to quite a bit of trouble.」

853:t_39:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... But if you're going to thank me, rather than $$アレルヤ$$, on this ha-」

853:t_39:8.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「I see, $$ＡＧ$$! You want me!!」

853:t_39:10.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「You're the one who asked for me! Let's have ourselves plenty of fun!」

853:t_39:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I was only trying to say... on this happy occasion, $$マリー$$ could... Why is this happening to me...?」

853:t_40:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Lately, little by little, I've begun to understand what you're trying to do.」

853:t_40:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And I've begun to see that it probably overlaps with my own mission too.」

853:t_40:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you sure you should trust me so easily...?」

853:t_40:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll put my faith in the conscience within you.」

853:t_40:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When you say that much, it becomes hard even for me to misbehave...」

853:t_40:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... You do owe me one over $$ヴェーダ$$, $$ティエリア$$...)

853:t_41:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I once cast my life away. With that resolve, I can do anything.」

853:t_41:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh...? You say you can do anything?」

853:t_41:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Yes. I could even cut an insolent robot in two without hesitation.」

853:t_41:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... You stopped me before I could even start...」

853:t_41:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Whoever acts first gains the upper hand... From now on, I won't let you set the pace.」

853:t_42:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$コーラサワー$$!」

853:t_42:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right, $$ＡＧ$$. It seems you've begun to understand how things work.」

853:t_42:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After hearing the story of you and $$マネキン$$ over and over, I can't help feeling that way.」

853:t_42:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Let me tell you, that's only our story so far. My future with the Colonel... no, the Brigadier General, has infinite possibilities.」

853:t_42:8.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「This is a happy occasion. Today, I'll tell you all about it.」

853:t_42:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-at least... Please keep it to about two hours...」

853:t_43:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've still got a long way to go, though.」

853:t_43:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I think you'll keep building on that 'long way to go' and end up somewhere no one else can reach, $$バナージ$$.」

853:t_43:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please show me just how far you can go, $$バナージ$$.」

853:t_43:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Y-yeah... You're awfully serious today, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_43:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You and the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ have something that makes me feel that way.」

853:t_44:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It may be presumptuous for me to say anything, but I pray you'll keep moving straight ahead without losing your way.」

853:t_44:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「If such a thing existed, I'd have been following it long ago...」

853:t_44:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This tunnel looks like it will be a long one...)

853:t_45:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm not sure... Maybe I'm still just a kid who doesn't understand anything...」

853:t_45:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「But now I intend to keep moving forward, to make up for all the detours I've taken.」

853:t_45:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is admirable. I'll watch your battles from here on.」

853:t_45:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Oh, no... I got so serious that I couldn't tell my 'Your sin deserves a $$バンシィ$$ sentence' joke...)
